hotel-b-lima.description: If you want to stay in a hotel that embodies Lima's past but blends it with it's contemporary lifestyle and art tastefully, then Hotel B in Barranco is the best choice. Located in the centre of a culinary and artistic neighbourhood in Lima, is located you want to be.

hotel-totem-madrid.description: Charming small, nicely designed hotel. THe hotel's lobby and restaurant makes hanging out in the hotel a pleasure. Hotel Totem is located in the heart of Madrid's Salamanca neighborhood, next to great restaurants and shops..

lululemon-metal-vent-tshirt.description: Comfort, durability and style. Most comfortable t-shirt I've used: I've run 3 marathons with them and train with them every day. Have been washed 50+ and look like new. Multiple colors to choose from, from basics to seasonal additions.

additionalSections.title: Performance Features
additionalSections.content: Designed for high-intensity training, this shirt features anti-stink technology and four-way stretch fabric that moves with you through any workout.

casa-lucia-buenos-aires.description: Tastefully remodelled classic Buenos Aires hotel in the most charming street in town. Next to an iconic bar, Floreria Atlántico. Beautiful pool and sylish lobby and bar.

muji-smooth-retractable-gel-pen-0.5-mm.headline: The perfect everyday writing companion
muji-smooth-retractable-gel-pen-0.5-mm.description: A smooth retractable gel pen with a 0.5 mm tip. Transparent and timeless design that embodies MUJI's philosophy of simplicity and functionality. This pen has become a cult favorite among designers, students, and professionals worldwide.
highlights: Available in black, blue, and red ink

additionalSections.title: Why It's Special
additionalSections.content: In a world of complicated designs, this pen stands out for what it doesn't have - no unnecessary features, no flashy colors, just pure functionality. It's the pen you reach for without thinking, and it never lets you down.

vitra-lampe-de-bureau.description: Jean Prouvé's lamp, designed in 1930 for the Cité Universitaire de Nancy, provides the perfect light for long nights of work.

galleryImages.alt: Vitra Lampe de Bureau side view

ghezzi-novak-manto-lamp.description: This versatile lamp gives any room a sense of movement and warmth through its curves, light and use of cotton.

cos-dark-khaki-overshirt.description: Provides a beautiful layer for winter and a perfect thing to wear alone over a plain white t-shirt in fall. I have a weakness for this kind of green, as you might start to learn.
